episodes.synopsis: While walking through the woods, Ash takes a random path that leads him to exciting encounters with many different types of Pokémon — and enemies.
episodes.title: The Road Most Traveled!

episodes.synopsis: Misty believes she's connected to a wild Clauncher by fate. Ash thinks his Corphish called dibs on it first. The only solution? A fishing battle!
episodes.title: A Fated Face-Off!

episodes.synopsis: To cheer up a heartsick Brock, Ash and his friends take him to a nearby flower field, where he gets lost chasing after a tricky Psychic-type Pokémon.
episodes.title: Must Be Our Heroes and the Witch!

episodes.synopsis: On a snowy mountaintop, Ash and the team try to help a gloomy Beartic by encouraging it to regain control of its ice powers.
episodes.title: Bearing Down Easy!

episodes.synopsis: Ash and friends decide to cheer on their old pal Squirtle at the Firefighting Squad Show, but the famous Pokémon's managers won't let the group say hi.
episodes.title: A Squad's Worth of Passion!

episodes.synopsis: When Team Rocket causes Pikachu to get separated from the rest of his group, Ash relies on their strong connection to track down his best friend.
episodes.title: The Same Moon, Now and Forever!

episodes.synopsis: A friendly Lapras takes Ash to a remote island, where a fellow Water-type needs the trainer's help. But Ash can't rescue the trapped Pokémon alone.
episodes.title: Ride, Lapras, Ride!

episodes.synopsis: When a supernatural entity starts stealing heart-shaped objects from houses in a small town, Ash, Brock and Misty team up to solve the mystery.
episodes.title: Getting to the Heart of It All!

episodes.synopsis: Team Rocket goes on a revenge mission to capture more Pokémon for their boss. The first step? Sending a Mime Jr. to gain Pikachu's trust.
episodes.title: Rocket Revengers!

episodes.synopsis: Latias takes Ash on a journey to figure out what happened to Latios. But rescuing the legendary Pokémon becomes a bigger battle than they bargained for.
episodes.title: Ash and Latios!

episodes.synopsis: As the group splits up, Ash and Pikachu return to Pallet Town, where they get some much-needed relaxation — before Team Rocket shows up.
episodes.title: The Rainbow and the Pokémon Master!
